rows.title: Report: Many states reining in spending as revenue growth slows
rows.standfirst: A new analysis shows that many states are tightening their belts. Whether Connecticut will follow their example next spring remains uncertain.

rows.title: Brand new CT budget already plagued by $170 million hole
rows.standfirst: CT’s $26 billion spending plan already has sprung $170 million in leaks, but Democratic leaders say they can patch the holes.

rows.title: What is CT’s Special Transportation Fund?
rows.standfirst: For nearly four decades, CT has designated a portion of its annual budget to finance upgrades to its aging transportation infrastructure.

rows.title: CT winter heating grants could jump $410 per household
rows.standfirst: Low-income CT households could receive an extra $410 each in heating assistance, but overall aid remains well below pre-pandemic levels.

rows.title: Union leaders say payroll problems persist for home care workers
rows.standfirst: CT home care workers complained for years about late paychecks, so the state hired a new vendor in March. Some say the problems persist.

rows.title: CT tax-free week 2024: What to know about the sales tax holiday
rows.standfirst: Connecticut’s sales tax-free week is a holiday designed for shoppers to buy clothing and footwear without paying sales tax.

rows.title: CT budget ‘guardrails’ hinder GOP plan to lower electric rates
rows.standfirst: CT Democrats say a Republican plan to dip into surplus funds to lower electric bills is an election-year stunt offering little relief.
